description: Pistachio (Pista Magaj) are nuts. They are an anytime snack and can be added to food.
benefits: They are a good source of fiber, nutrients and antioxidants
funFacts: 26th February is celebrated as National Pistachio Day
It is known as “Happy Nut” in China and “Smiling Nut” in Iran
They have as much protein as an egg

description: Almonds (Badam) are crunchy, mildly sweet nuts. They make a filling anytime snack and go into many sweets and drinks.
benefits: Rich in vitamin E and healthy fats
funFacts: Botanically, an almond is the seed of a fruit, not a true nut
California grows most of the world’s almonds
Almond trees are among the first to bloom at the end of winter

description: Cashews (Kaju) are soft, buttery nuts with a gentle sweetness. They are enjoyed as a snack and used to make gravies and sweets rich and creamy.
benefits: Good fats that support the heart
funFacts: Cashews grow at the bottom of a fruit called the cashew apple
Raw cashew shells hold a harsh oil, so cashews are always shelled before sale
Cashew trees are native to Brazil

description: Dried Mulberries are small, soft and naturally sweet. A handful makes a tasty, chewy snack.
benefits: Good source of iron and vitamin C
funFacts: Silkworms feed on mulberry leaves
Mulberries belong to the same plant family as figs
Mulberry trees have been grown for thousands of years

description: Walnuts (Akhrot) are crunchy nuts with a rich, slightly earthy taste. They are a favourite snack and a great addition to desserts and salads.
funFacts: Walnuts have been eaten by people for thousands of years
A walnut kernel looks like a tiny brain
Walnut trees can live for hundreds of years

description: Anjeer (Dried Fig) is soft, naturally sweet and full of tiny crunchy seeds. It is a classic dry fruit for snacking and desserts.
benefits: Rich in fiber that supports digestion
funFacts: Figs are among the oldest fruits grown by people
A fig is actually a cluster of tiny flowers inside a soft skin
Soaking anjeer overnight makes it softer and sweeter
uses: Soaked overnight in water or milk

description: Apricot (Jardalu) is a sweet and tangy dried fruit. It is soft, chewy and a favourite anytime snack.
funFacts: The apricot belongs to the same family as peach, plum and almond
Its botanical name means “Armenian plum”
Apricots dry well, so they keep their sweetness for months

description: Black Raisins (Kali Kishmish) are sweet, dark and juicy dried grapes. They are loved as a snack and in sweets.
benefits: Good for digestion when soaked overnight
funFacts: Black raisins are grapes dried in the sun or shade
It takes several kilos of grapes to make one kilo of raisins
Soaked black raisin water is a popular morning drink

description: Golden Raisins (Kishmish) are sweet, soft and golden dried grapes. A small handful is a great pick-me-up snack.
benefits: A healthy replacement for sugary snacks
funFacts: Raisins are simply grapes that have been dried
It takes about four kilos of grapes to make one kilo of raisins
Golden raisins are often dried in the shade to keep their colour

description: Premium Dates (Khajoor) are soft, sticky and caramel sweet. They give quick energy and are a staple at every celebration.
benefits: A healthy sweetener for desserts and shakes
funFacts: Date palms have been grown for thousands of years
Dates are traditionally used to break the fast in Ramadan
The date palm is often called the “Tree of Life”

description: Premium Saffron (Kesar) is made of deep red threads that give food a golden colour and a rich aroma. A few strands are enough.
benefits: Adds natural colour and aroma to food
Traditionally used in warm saffron milk
Needed only in very small amounts
funFacts: Saffron is one of the most expensive spices in the world
Each crocus flower has only three red threads, picked by hand
The threads turn water or milk golden within minutes

description: Premium Sunflower Seeds are mild, nutty and crunchy. They are a light snack that is easy to add to any meal.
benefits: Source of magnesium and healthy fats
funFacts: Young sunflowers turn their heads to follow the sun
One sunflower head holds hundreds of seeds
Sunflowers are native to North America

description: Nuqol is a traditional sweet treat made with a sugar coating around a crunchy centre. It is served at celebrations and with tea.
benefits: A treat for festivals and guests
funFacts: Nuqol is a popular sweet at weddings and festivals in Afghanistan and Iran
It is often served in small bowls to guests with tea
Its coloured coating makes it a favourite for gift boxes

description: Pine Nuts (Chilgoza) are small, creamy seeds with a soft, buttery and mildly sweet taste. They are a premium nut for cooking and gifting.
funFacts: Pine nuts are the seeds hidden inside pine cones
They take years to grow, which is why they are rare
Pine nuts are the key ingredient in pesto
